column1: # Two lui values combined into one address: the check of cmpkit 86da41d3ef68's known fail-open (two or more lui
# values joined by add / sub / sh*add into a load / store / jalr / AMO base are not compared as an address;
# the kit pairs a lui only with an addi / addiw / load / store / jalr on the lui register itself, so a
# combined base is invisible to it and to luiscan's memfed count).
# Method: luipairs.py (this directory), a MAY dataflow over each function's control-flow graph; it never
# drops a path, so an empty result proves no such site exists. Both sides of every pair are scanned.
# Function bodies scanned: 108. Sites with 2 or more lui values: 0. Sites with 1: 125.
# Compressed (2-byte) parcels in those bodies: 0. Every lui value that reaches a base is 0x1000 or
# -0x1000, the page constant of the frame arithmetic, which lies in no allocated section of any image.
